e.title: DNB（荷兰央行）：统计栏目含养老金基金平均覆盖率
e.title_en: DNB (De Nederlandsche Bank): a statistics section including pension funds’ average funding ratio
e.title_hk: DNB（荷蘭央行）：統計欄目含養老金基金平均覆蓋率
e.summary: 荷兰央行与审慎监管机构：统计栏目提供家庭储蓄、房贷利率、FDI 等金融经济统计，并基于监管信息发布养老金基金平均覆盖率
e.summary_en: The Dutch central bank and prudential supervisor: statistics on household savings, mortgage rates and FDI, plus supervisory-derived data such as the average funding ratio of pension funds
e.summary_hk: 荷蘭央行與審慎監管機構：統計欄目提供家庭儲蓄、房貸利率、FDI 等金融經濟統計，並基於監管信息發布養老金基金平均覆蓋率
e.body:
**DNB（De Nederlandsche Bank，荷兰央行）** 是**荷兰的中央银行与审慎监管机构**，同时监管**银行、保险公司与养老金基金**。本条目属本轮**养老金与退休保障数据层**——实测池内**荷兰相关条目接近 0**（此前仅有一条会议类误命中），而**荷兰是全球人均养老金资产最高、DB 向 DC 转型最受关注的市场之一**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：DNB 英文首页 **234KB**；⭐ **统计栏目 `/en/statistics`（221.2KB）实测标题为「Statistics | De Nederlandsche Bank」**，正文写明「we provide the latest financial and economic statistics on **household savings, mortgage interest rates and foreign direct investment**. We also publish **data based on supervisory information, such as the average funding ratio of pension funds**」——**即它把「监管信息」直接转化为公开统计，其中包含养老金基金的平均覆盖率**。页面另实测可见 **Pensions 专题入口**（`/en/current-economic-issues/pensions/towards-the-new-pension-system/`，即**荷兰养老金制度改革**专题）与金融监管相关栏目。⚠️ **一处如实记录**：我猜测的 `/en/data` 路径实测 **404**（站点结构以 `/en/statistics` 为准）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上荷兰与「监管信息转统计」这一形态**——池内养老金数据源多为**监管机构发布的行业统计**（[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[hkmc]]、[[fsca]]）或**专业团体**（[[assa]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]），**而「央行基于监管报送数据发布养老金基金覆盖率」这一形态此前没有**；**覆盖率（funding ratio）是 DB 体系最核心的风险指标**，其历史序列对**低利率环境下的养老金偿付能力**研究是直接材料。**② 荷兰案例本身重要**——荷兰养老金体系**正在从 DB 向 DC 转型**（页面专题即「Towards the new pension system」），对做**养老金改革比较**的学生，这是**与智利 AFP（[[cmf-chile]]）、澳洲 super（[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]）、香港 MPF（[[mpf-fund-platform]]）并列的第五个制度样本**（加上英国 [[gad-uk]] 与美国 [[pbgc]] 共六个）。**③ 家庭储蓄与房贷利率统计**也直接相关——家庭资产负债与住房抵押是**寿险与按揭保险**的需求侧输入（对应 [[hkmc]] 的按揭保险口径）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、统计栏目页的标题与正文要点，以及养老金专题入口**，**但未下载任何统计数据（DNB 统计多通过其 StatLine/API 提供，本次未核实取数路径）**；**②** 覆盖率等数据的**频率、口径与历史长度未核实**；**③** `/en/data` 实测 404（已记录）；**④** DNB 数据**以荷兰监管报送为基础**，**口径与其他市场不可直接比较**。**核实说明**：英文首页（234KB）与 `/en/statistics`（221.2KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取正文；养老金专题链接在页面内实测可见；**未下载统计数据、未核实取数路径**。
e.body_en:
**DNB (De Nederlandsche Bank)** is **the Dutch central bank and prudential supervisor**, overseeing **banks, insurers and pension funds**. This entry belongs to this round’s **pension and retirement security data layer** — a measured search found **essentially zero Netherlands-related entries** (only one conference item matched by accident), while **the Netherlands has among the highest pension assets per capita and is one of the most watched markets for the DB-to-DC transition**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the DNB English homepage is **234KB**; ⭐ the **statistics section `/en/statistics` (221.2KB)** has the **measured title "Statistics | De Nederlandsche Bank"** and states that DNB provides "the latest financial and economic statistics on **household savings, mortgage interest rates and foreign direct investment**" and also publishes "**data based on supervisory information, such as the average funding ratio of pension funds**" — i.e. it **converts supervisory reporting directly into public statistics, including pension funds’ average funding ratio**. The site also shows a **Pensions topic entry** (`/en/current-economic-issues/pensions/towards-the-new-pension-system/`, i.e. the **Dutch pension reform**) and financial-supervision sections. ⚠️ **One honest note**: the `/en/data` path I guessed measured **404** (the site’s structure runs through `/en/statistics`).

For RIAA: **① it adds both the Netherlands and the "supervisory data turned into statistics" form** — pension data sources in the corpus are mostly **industry statistics published by supervisors** ([[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[hkmc]], [[fsca]]) or **professional bodies** ([[assa]], [[institut-des-actuaires]]), whereas **"a central bank publishing pension funds’ funding ratio from supervisory reporting" had no precedent**; **the funding ratio is the core risk metric of any DB system**, and its history is direct material for research on **pension solvency in a low-rate environment**. **② The Dutch case matters in itself** — the Dutch system **is shifting from DB to DC** (the site’s own topic is "Towards the new pension system"), making it **a fifth institutional sample** alongside Chile’s AFP ([[cmf-chile]]), Australian super ([[apra-superannuation-statistics]]) and Hong Kong MPF ([[mpf-fund-platform]]) — six including the UK ([[gad-uk]]) and US ([[pbgc]]). **③ Household savings and mortgage-rate statistics** are also relevant — household balance sheets and mortgages are demand-side inputs for **life and mortgage insurance** (matching the mortgage-insurance angle of [[hkmc]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the title and key body points of the statistics page, and the pensions topic entry**, **but downloaded no statistics** (DNB data is largely served through StatLine/API, and **the extraction path was not verified**); **②** the **frequency, definitions and history length** of the funding-ratio data were not verified; **③** `/en/data` measured 404 (recorded); **④** DNB data **rests on Dutch supervisory reporting** and **is not directly comparable across markets**. **Verification note**: the English homepage (234KB) and `/en/statistics` (221.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their text read; the pensions topic link was observed on the page; **no statistics were downloaded and no extraction path was verified**.
e.body_hk:
**DNB（De Nederlandsche Bank，荷蘭央行）** 是**荷蘭的中央銀行與審慎監管機構**，同時監管**銀行、保險公司與養老金基金**。本條目屬本輪**養老金與退休保障數據層**——實測池內**荷蘭相關條目接近 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：英文首頁 **234KB**；⭐ **統計欄目 `/en/statistics`（221.2KB）標題實測為「Statistics | De Nederlandsche Bank」**，正文寫明提供**家庭儲蓄、房貸利率、外商直接投資**等統計，**並基於監管信息發布「養老金基金平均覆蓋率」**；頁面另實測可見**荷蘭養老金制度改革專題入口**與金融監管欄目。⚠️ **如實記錄**：我猜測的 `/en/data` 實測 **404**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上荷蘭與「監管信息轉統計」這一形態**——「**央行基於監管報送發布養老金覆蓋率**」此前沒有；**覆蓋率是 DB 體系最核心的風險指標**，其歷史序列對**低利率環境下的養老金償付能力**研究是直接材料；**② 荷蘭案例本身重要**——正在**由 DB 向 DC 轉型**，構成**第五個制度樣本**（加上 [[cmf-chile]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]，以及英國 [[gad-uk]] 與美國 [[pbgc]] 共六個）；**③ 家庭儲蓄與房貸利率統計**是**壽險與按揭保險**的需求側輸入（對應 [[hkmc]]）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁、統計欄目標題與正文要點、養老金專題入口**，**但未下載任何統計數據（DNB 多經 StatLine/API 提供，本次未核實取數路徑）**；**②** 覆蓋率數據的**頻率、口徑與歷史長度未核實**；**③** `/en/data` 實測 404（已記錄）；**④** DNB 數據**口徑不可直接跨市場比較**。**核實說明**：兩頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載統計數據**。
